title: Jagged Canadian Hazelnut Salad
description: A salty and crunchy vegetarian dish featuring hazelnuts and lardons, served in a bento box, reminiscent of Canadian nostalgia
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spread the chopped hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 10 minutes.
Remove the hazelnuts from the oven and let them cool.
In a large skillet, render the lardons over medium heat until crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced red onion, and toasted hazelnuts.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Divide the salad among 4 bento boxes.
Top each salad with crispy lardons.
